blockers.th: PERIOD_STATE labels (subcon-accept.jsx L50-53: ตรวจรับแล้ว/ขอตรวจรับ/ยังไม่ถึง/ตีกลับแก้ไข) + ACCEPT_CHECKLIST labels (L57-63, 5 items) were DROPPED by both raw extractors (called dynamic/data-array), but RECOVERED here as keys by parity — SUB_TYPES (subcon.jsx L396, const string array) and SUBC_METHOD .l labels (const object) are keyed in this same round, and these are the same shape (fixed hardcoded Thai UI labels rendered verbatim: PERIOD_STATE via <StatusBadge>{st.l}</StatusBadge> subcon-accept2 L102; ACCEPT_CHECKLIST via {label} L195).
blockers.issue: REVIEWER DECISION NEEDED: if the port sources period-status labels or the acceptance-criteria checklist from the API instead of hardcoding, drop these 9 keys (subcon.statusRequested + the 3 deduped status keys' PERIOD_STATE usage + subcon.checkItem*×5). Current prototype hardcodes them → keyed for fidelity. Non-blocking for apply; port can prune unused.

blockers.th: Unit-suffix props: subcon.unitMBaht ("M ฿", subcon.jsx L55/56/57, subcon-accept L81, subcon-accept2 L42) and subcon.unitBaht ("฿", subcon-accept2 L43/44) are MiniKpi unit= props.
blockers.issue: BORDERLINE UI-vs-formatting: kept as keys (structural unit slots; "M ฿" carries the 'M' abbreviation). Bare table-header "%" (subcon.jsx L154, subcon-accept2 L88) was NOT keyed — dropped as symbol, consistent with progress-screen ruling. Reviewer may downgrade unitBaht "฿" to static formatting if desired.

notes: SCOPE: 4 subcon screens (subcon.progress=subcon.jsx; subcon.contracts=subcon-accept.jsx; subcon.accept+subcon.handover=subcon-accept2.jsx) share ONE namespace subcon.* → I resolved every slug collision so the flat dict has NO duplicate keys. Renames from raw extractions: pageTitle→progressTitle/contractsTitle/acceptTitle/handoverTitle (4 different values); subtitle→progressSubtitle/contractsSubtitle; addBtn kept for progress \"เพิ่มผู้รับเหมา\" but contracts \"สร้างสัญญา/WO\"→createContractBtn; kpiTotalLabel kept progress \"ผู้รับเหมาทั้งหมด\" but contracts \"มูลค่ารวม\"→kpiTotalValueLabel; kpiPendingLabel kept progress \"งวดรออนุมัติ\" but contracts/accept \"งวดรอตรวจรับ\"→kpiPendingAccept; colProgress kept progress \"คืบหน้า\" but contracts \"ความคืบหน้า\"→colProgressLong; colValue kept progress \"มูลค่า\" but \"มูลค่า (฿)\"→colValueBaht; progress kpiPendingSub \"มูลค่า {value} M ฿\"→kpiPendingSubValue (distinct from shared kpiPendingSub \"ผู้รับเหมาขอตรวจ\"). DEDUP within subcon namespace (byte-identical→ONE key): subcon.subcontractor \"ผู้รับเหมา\" (all 4 screens), unitContract \"สัญญา\", unitMBaht \"M ฿\", colValueBaht \"มูลค่า (฿)\", colPeriod \"งวด\", colDetail \"รายละเอียด\", colMethod \"วิธีแบ่งงวด\", colAccept \"ตรวจรับ\", handoverDoc \"เอกสารส่งมอบ\", closeBtn \"ปิด\", kpiAccepted \"ตรวจรับแล้ว\" (KPI+PERIOD_STATE.accepted), statusNotReached \"ยังไม่ถึง\" (payment status+PERIOD_STATE.pending), rejectBtn \"ตีกลับแก้ไข\" (AcceptForm btn+PERIOD_STATE.rejected). RECLASSIFIED-DROPPED: bare \"%\" table headers (subcon.jsx L154 already dropped by extractor; subcon-accept2 L88 extractor had keyed as subcon.colPct — I DROPPED it as ICON_OR_NUMBER for consistency). CROSS-NAMESPACE twins kept separate by design (fixed namespace per screen): \"มูลค่า (฿)\"=subcon.colValueBaht vs accept.colValue; \"ปิด\"=subcon.closeBtn vs accept.closeBtn; \"โหลด\"=subcon.downloadBtn vs accept.docLoadBtn; \"ดาวน์โหลด {name}\"=subcon.downloadToast vs accept.toastDownload; \"ประเภท\"/\"โครงการ\" etc. GLYPH: all tricky glyphs byte-verified via xxd/python — U+2212 MINUS (paymentBreakdown L232, NOT hyphen), U+2192 arrow (distanceCalcHint/infoExisting/acceptSubmitBtn/approvePeriodToast), U+00B7 middot (pervasive), U+2014 em-dash (infoExisting/infoNew/modalSubtitle/noDocsEmpty/failWarning/partialWarn/accept.subtitle/footerInfo), U+26A0 warn (defectLabel/partialWarn/tabRejected/rejectDefectLine), U+2713 check (thresholdMet), U+0E3F ฿, ASCII 0x22 quotes in toastBind/toastAdd/infoNew (NOT curly), sigDateLine dots=12/9/9. English-literal keys (lang=en, all 4 slots=literal): subcon.progressBreadcrumb/colRetention/rowDp/exportExcelBtn/typeLandscape/phEmail/colMilestone/docSubtitle, accept.exportBtn. verified_glyph=true on all (every source line read + tricky codepoints dumped). All *.jsx line refs are 1-indexed to the files as read. CompanySwitcher (company-accept.jsx L24-99) correctly excluded (already ported). Placeholder skeletons preserve static skeleton; interpolated {n}/{value}/{pct}/{qty}/{unit}/{name}/{code}/{no}/{desc}/{start}/{due}/{range}/{target}/{net}/{count}/{total}/{retention} are DATA.
